brief: How to relax when stressed — 5 mindful steps from a therapist.

slots.searchQuery: How to relax when you're stressed

slots.body: Pause and name the tension resting in your body without judgment. Awareness is the first gentle doorway back to calm.
Breathe slowly through your nose, letting each exhale soften your shoulders and quiet your racing thoughts.
Place one hand on your heart and feel its steady rhythm anchor you to the present moment.
Scan your surroundings and name five soft things you can see, hear, or touch right now.
Whisper a kind phrase to yourself, offering the same patience you would give a dear friend.
Carry this softness forward, letting one small ritual hold you through the rest of your day.

slots.headline: Begin again, gently
slots.body: You deserve rest that is slow, simple, and entirely yours. Let this be your starting place.
